name: garmin-mcp
description: MCP server for Garmin Connect IQ developers. Ask Claude about your store apps, SDK builds and the simulator. Read-only by default.
long_description: MCP server for Garmin Connect IQ developers. Ask Claude about your store apps, SDK builds and the simulator. Read-only by default; anything public waits for your yes. Run `garmin-mcp auth login` once: a browser opens, you sign in with Remember me, and sessions renew silently after that. Unofficial; not affiliated with Garmin.

allow_writes.title: Allow writes
allow_writes.description: Expose write tools. Public actions (publishing, listing edits, review replies) still wait for your approval.

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: Empty for the defaults, 'all', or e.g. '+connect'.
